page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.2xlarge is a KVM-based virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate moderate multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. The instance achieved an average rating in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Passmark CPU tests, but fell into the bottom 25% for single-core stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores. Memory bandwidth shows a similar split, with average cached read speeds of 402.34 GB/sec but weak uncached large-block read performance at 38.36 GB/sec. Cryptographic and vector processing capabilities are supported by AVX, AVX-512F, and AES instruction sets, which help sustain average performance in tasks like software compilation and ray tracing.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio, this instance is positioned for general-purpose workloads. However, its weak single-threaded performance, low uncached memory bandwidth, and poor results in database operations and Redis SET benchmarks suggest it is less suitable for high-throughput transactional databases or latency-sensitive applications. It is best utilized for moderate multi-threaded workloads, basic web serving, and light computational tasks such as software compilation or small-scale model inference where extreme single-core speed is not critical.
